Situation: Risperidone 125 mg/0.35 mL syringes are not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 197 syringes (37.1 days on hand). Corvale General holds 183 syringes (22.8 days on hand). No public FDA shortage signal exists for our plants.

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include risperidone as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is adequate at both campuses. No shortage declaration is warranted.

Recommended actions:
1. Continue standard inventory monitoring at both sites; Pharmacy Buyer approves.
2. Maintain current par levels and ordering cadence; Pharmacy Director approves.
3. Report any future supply disruption to the P&T Committee immediately; Pharmacy Buyer approves.

Not recommended: Allocation restrictions, therapeutic interchange protocols, or emergency purchasing at this time.
